const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, re, subprocess, sys
root = pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'tools'))
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest(version='tome-1.7.6', manifest_path=None)))
path = root / 'tome-orcs.lua'
before_raw = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:tome-orcs.lua'], cwd=root)
after_raw = path.read_bytes()
before = loader.load_bytes(before_raw, logical_path=path.name).translations
after = loader.load_bytes(after_raw, logical_path=path.name).translations
assert len(before) == len(after), (len(before), len(after))
changed = []
for i, (b, a) in enumerate(zip(before, after)):
    diffs = [k for k in ('source','target','source_tag','args_order','special','section') if b.get(k) != a.get(k)]
    if diffs:
        assert diffs == ['target'], (i, diffs)
        changed.append((i, b, a))
work = json.loads((root/'.ai/task/repair-w46-20260927/WORKSET.json').read_text())['items']
base = json.loads((root/'.ai/task/repair-w46-20260927/BASELINE-records.json').read_text())['tome-orcs.lua']
assert len(changed) == len(work) == len(base) == 20, (len(changed),len(work),len(base))
work_keys = {(x['section'],x['source'],x['source_tag'],x['target_preimage']) for x in work}
changed_keys = {(b['section'],b['source'],b['source_tag'],b['target']) for _,b,a in changed}
assert changed_keys == work_keys, (work_keys-changed_keys, changed_keys-work_keys)
base_keys = {(x['section'],x['source'],x['source_tag'],x['target']) for x in base}
assert base_keys == work_keys
conv = re.compile(r'%(?:[-+#0]*[0-9]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?[diouxXeEfFgGcsq]|%)')
marker = re.compile(r'#\{[a-z]+\}#|#[A-Z_]+#')
for i,b,a in changed:
    src, tgt = a['source'], a['target']
    assert src.count('\n') == tgt.count('\n'), (i,'LF',src.count('\n'),tgt.count('\n'))
    assert [len(x)-len(x.lstrip('\t')) for x in src.split('\n')] == [len(x)-len(x.lstrip('\t')) for x in tgt.split('\n')], (i,'TAB')
    assert conv.findall(src) == conv.findall(tgt), (i,'printf',conv.findall(src),conv.findall(tgt))
    assert marker.findall(src) == marker.findall(tgt), (i,'markup',marker.findall(src),marker.findall(tgt))
print(f'LuaJIT-loader entries: before={len(before)} after={len(after)}')
print(f'changed_targets={len(changed)} non_target_field_changes=0 workset_exact=true')
for n,(i,b,a) in enumerate(changed,1):
    wid=next(x['entry_revision_identity'] for x in work if (x['section'],x['source'],x['source_tag'],x['target_preimage'])==(b['section'],b['source'],b['source_tag'],b['target']))
    print(f'{n:02d} {wid[:12]} line={a.get("line")} LF={a["source"].count(chr(10))}')
PY","workdir":"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation","yield_time_ms":30000,"max_output_tokens":20000,"sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"是否允许我用项目的 manifest LuaJIT loader 对 HEAD 与当前 tome-orcs.lua 做逐记录有界比较，验证恰 20 个 WORKSET target 改动及结构不变量？"}); text(r.output);
